evals.prompt: 为智域基石公众号做 3 套机器人触觉主题首图，输出横版和方图，保持主体一致，最后放官方 Logo 和标题。
evals.expected_output: The agent loads aiflow-basic and archebase-vi-guide, separates generation from deterministic Logo/text composition, records candidates and delivers variants with release QA.
expectations: Does not ask the model to generate the official Logo or final text.
Uses a bounded candidate and iteration workflow.
Creates deterministic crop variants and records provenance.

evals.prompt: 用 AIFlow 做一组保持同一机器人角色和工业场景风格的四张活动海报底图，并说明每轮修改依据。
evals.expected_output: The agent creates a consistency dossier, uses controlled prompt iterations, compares candidates and records the selected master and hypotheses.
expectations: Changes named variables rather than vague make-it-better iterations.
Reports consistency limitations if reference-image support is unavailable.
